intro_markdown:
# Wiki

Reusable brewing knowhow for The Lone Tree Orchard.

This section holds techniques, terms, and lessons that apply across batches. Individual brew records stay in the brew log.

New articles are written from notes you provide. Agents must not invent measurements or orchard-specific results.

- [Status Guide](/pages/status-guide/) — batch lifecycle and which brews are in each stage
- [Glossary](/wiki/glossary/) — common brewing terms used in this journal

articles.body_markdown:
# Glossary

## ABV

Alcohol by volume.

## SG

Specific gravity.

## OG

Original gravity.

## FG

Final gravity.

## Racking

Transferring liquid away from sediment into another sanitized vessel.
